speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are experiencing weakness and fatigue; to help me identify the cause, could you tell me how long these symptoms have been present and if you have noticed any other specific changes in your health?

speaker: Patient
text: 33-year-old woman. The patient reports feeling extremely fatigued and weak, especially towards the end of the day, to the point of difficulty in self-care. She mentions experiencing these symptoms currently. The patient has been traveling, hiking, and camping recently and notes having had multiple illnesses in the recent past.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Chronic Fatigue Syndrome (ME/CFS)

Hello, I am Dr. Agent. Given your history of recent illnesses and travel, could you tell me if your fatigue has persisted for more than six months and if it worsens significantly after physical or mental exertion? REQUEST TEST: CBC, CMP, TSH, Ferritin, ESR, Vitamin D, B12.
